name: Chicken, Chorizo, Pesto & Mozzarella Panini
description: Crispy toasted ciabatta filled with chicken, chorizo, pesto and melted mozzarella. Use pre-cooked chicken for a 10-minute meal, or cook the chicken fresh with the chorizo and spices.
instructions: Slice the chorizo and fry over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until lightly crisp and the fat begins to render.
Slice the pre-cooked chicken and toss through the chorizo for 1-2 minutes until hot.
Split the ciabatta and spread the pesto over both cut sides.
Fill with the chicken, chorizo and mozzarella and season with black pepper.
Close the panini and toast in a panini press until the bread is crisp and the mozzarella has melted.

substitutions.label: Cook the chicken fresh
substitutions.note: Dice the chicken, season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, dried oregano and black pepper, then fry with the chorizo until cooked through. Continue with the recipe as normal.
